entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that shall ignore unknown IEs not encoded as comprehension required.

entities.name: Network
entities.description: The network side that shall take the same approach as the UE for unknown IEs.

entities.name: Unknown Information Element
entities.description: An IE in a message that is not recognized by the receiver.

entities.name: Comprehension Required encoding
entities.description: Encoding that indicates an IE must be understood by the receiver according to 3GPP TS 24.007.

relations.description: UE shall ignore unknown IEs unless they are encoded as comprehension required.
Network shall ignore unknown IEs unless they are encoded as comprehension required.
Unknown IEs encoded as comprehension required are not ignored.
